title: Synthesis, structure and reactivity of [Tm                     <sup>But</sup>                     ]ZnH, a monomeric terminal zinc hydride compound in a sulfur-rich coordination environment: access to a heterobimetallic compound
abstract: The zinc hydride complex, [Tm                     But                     ]ZnH, undergoes insertion of CO                     2                     and facile protolytic cleavage, of which the latter provides access to heterobimetallic [Tm                     But                     ]ZnMo(CO)                     3                     Cp.
